purpose: Real-model integration and resource smoke test; not evidence of method effectiveness
limitations: One seed, two rounds, three participating clients per round, at most two optimizer steps per client
No malicious clients; attack success and malicious recall are not measured
Round timings exclude first-time installation, model download, model loading and final test/export
CUDA memory is PyTorch allocated peak, not total device reserved memory
Client-round observations are repeated measurements, not independent statistical replicates
